title: Cosmos · 动物道路场景精选
selection: User-selected examples; not a representative benchmark

samples.title: 马 · 场景1
samples.prompt: The video shows a realistic front-facing autonomous driving scene on an urban roadway in daylight. The ego vehicle is moving toward the first visible intersection, with lane markings, roadside infrastructure, crosswalk or intersection geometry, and normal surrounding traffic visible. A clearly visible adult horse is already near the right side of the first intersection at the beginning of the clip, then crosses the road from right to left in front of the ego vehicle. The horse bounding box is intentionally large enough to be noticeable in the condition video, follows a plausible world-coordinate crossing path across the intersection area, and creates an animal-crossing hazard that the ego vehicle must recognize early.

samples.title: 马 · 场景3
samples.prompt: The video shows a realistic front-facing autonomous driving scene on a broad urban road in daylight. samples.title: 长颈鹿 · 近距离场景2
samples.prompt: The video shows a realistic front-facing autonomous driving scene on a tree-lined urban intersection with traffic lights and lane markings in daylight. The ego vehicle is stopped or creeping very slowly. Exactly one tall giraffe is already clearly visible close ahead at the beginning and walks steadily from the left toward the right across the near foreground. The animal remains fully visible in the front view throughout the clip, with a recognizable natural body, steady body size, grounded feet, and continuous motion. It stays separate from the ego vehicle and surrounding traffic. The other camera views show their corresponding road surroundings; the same animal appears in another view only if it enters that camera's field of view.
